comparison.objective: Candidate dynamically commissions a robot-axis damper; record sets a DIP-switch address.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests tool insertion, setscrew torque, counterholding, collar adjustment, and physical impact cycling; record concerns operating small binary switches.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate scores repeatable non-bottoming stops and locked-setting retention. Record has no body, specs, setup, address pattern, or scoring thresholds.
comparison.reason: Selecting an electronic address is meaningfully different from mechanically tuning and locking an energy absorber, despite both involving small controls.
